purpose: Educational original low-poly whole-organism living reconstruction; maker self-tests are not independent acceptance.

criteria.description: Actual transformed component dimensions, true closed outward solids, strict positive-volume attachment without relying on boundary witnesses, natural cavities unblocked, global exposure; source reopen, two distinct PID semantic rebuilds, project and Khronos checks.

Personally inspect eight exact512frames and lossless sheet plus exactsubject details. Articulation, grooves, plates, openings and anatomically important exposed surfaces must read; counts or names alone are insufficient.

Nearly spherical many-hundreds mosaic theca with subdued smooth epithek; exposed pore-rhombs or steinkern pegs must not be misrepresented as exterior living spikes. Short raised oral neck with selected four facets anchored to RM Ec3304; branched biserial feeding brachioles, chosen four-to-eight interpretation explicitly not specimen-measured complete appendages. High posterior five-valved anal pyramid and smaller gonopore to its upper right; elongate oral slit is inferred from primary text, detailed oral plate map unresolved; fine short basal attachment. Whole-organism genus-level living reconstruction anchored to Swedish E.aurantium aurantium external theca and RM Ec3304 four-facet oral photograph. Genus-level branching evidence supplements this incomplete specimen transparently; four-to-eight tips, plate sampling and short attachment are interpretive, not an exact biological census. Nominate five anal valves must not be replaced with suprum four-valve specimen.

numeric_semantics: Diagnostic counts and anatomical relations above are gates. Artistic sampling counts/lengths/colors in parameters are nominal design decisions, not species measurements. Cupressocrinites adult arm source minimum20brachials is a genuine hard lower bound. No percentage exposure or microscopic contact threshold invented.
component_measurement_contract: Editable semantic vertex groups with actual transformed bounds and closed solid component ranges. Every anatomical plate/ossicle physically present and readable. Contact and whole-scene visibility audited separately.
contact_policy: Required component attachment has strictly internal positive-volume overlap, not only coplanar boundary vertices. Natural openings and grooves remain unblocked by other solids. Whole-scene exposure assessed for all relevant directions including appropriate closeups; no arbitrary numeric exposure gate.

retain: Compact sphere, short neck, forked fine appendages, shallow mosaic, short basal attachment, coral/ivory palette
correct_before_geometry: Concept anal pyramid lies too low: final upper third of theca, gonopore above and right.

Concept slit tall strongly raised lip is exaggerated; final small recessed elongate opening in modest neck.
